text:
jamie-sales: Heads-up: Quasar Industries is stuck on the POC because their CISO wants an encrypted VPC peering + a temporary uplift in throughput for an executive demo tomorrow 14:00 UTC. They also want cost clarity for the burst. Need quick ops/security signoff.

nate-eng: Got it. Do we have a playbook for short-lived peering + burst billing? Trying to avoid manual infra changes if possible. :eyes: 

olga-ops: We have a controlled flow for this. We can create a peering with a 4-hour TTL and an egress override. Security will need the CIDR whitelist and a dedicated audit stream. What CIDRs and contact?

jamie-sales: Customer provided CIDR 203.0.113.128/26. Demo window 13:30-14:45 UTC. Exec asked for a hard cap on spend — they'd accept up to $1500 for the demo. Need internal pre-approve.

tara-security: Quick security checklist: 1) TLS-only endpoints, 2) restrict to exact /32 IPs where possible, 3) separate KMS alias for demo logs, 4) short retention. I can auto-approve if ops shares the exact ACL snippet and runbook.

olga-ops: Draft ACL below, please review:

```
peering: quasar-demo-2026
from_project: redwood-demo-tenant
to_cidr: 203.0.113.128/26
allowed_ports: [443]
duration_hours: 4
egress_limit_mbps: 25
acl: [ "203.0.113.130/32", "203.0.113.131/32" ]
logging: demo-kms-alias: "alias/quasar-demo-logs"
```

nate-eng: ACL looks fine. Two engineering asks: enable KV cache pre-warm and set model-fallback to hosted endpoint so demo doesn't fail if peering goes down. Can ops set a health-check and fallback route?

olga-ops: Yes. I will enable pre-warm cron and configure a weighted route: primary=peered, fallback=hosted-1 (weight 0). Health-check every 10s.

devops-bot: [change-request] quasar-demo-2026 requested by olga-ops 1h to live; runbook RB-10033 created.

jamie-sales: Who can approve the $1500 demo cap quickly? We need a budget owner to confirm. @carter-csm?

carter-csm: I can approve the capped demo billing. Please add the PO note and I'll send the confirmation to procurement. Also confirm if Quasar needs a signed SOW addendum — legal might require it for peering.

tara-security: I reviewed the ACL. One condition: logs must route to customer KMS alias and we must provide their security reviewer read-only access via SSO. If olga posts the final ACL with the KMS alias I will sign off.

olga-ops: Updated ACL pushed to the ticket with KMS alias "alias/quasar-demo-logs" and exact /32s for the demo hosts. Deploying staged peering now.

devops-bot: [deploy] peering quasar-demo-2026 staged in eu-central-1. Runbook RB-10033 status: staged -> pending validation.

nate-eng: Quick smoke from a restricted host: TLS handshake OK, model latency ~110ms with KV warmup. Everything green on my side.

tara-security: Signing off now. Conditions met: KMS alias set, retention=30d, SSO access granted. :white_check_mark:

jamie-sales: Great — Carter will send PO note. Quick reminder: teardown 16:00 UTC (15min after window) unless exec requests extension. Olga, can you schedule automatic revert?

olga-ops: Teardown scheduled for 16:15 UTC. I'll post a confirm message once peering is reverted.

carter-csm: PO email queued and procurement looped in. Sending now.

devops-bot: [reminder] teardown job for quasar-demo-2026 scheduled at 16:15 UTC.

olga-ops: Teardown complete. Peering removed, egress caps reverted. Confirmed logs were archived to the customer KMS alias. Closing thread.

jamie-sales: Thanks team. I will update Quasar and close the POC ticket. :rocket:
